item.title: Grammy 1.97
item.description:
New

  • Try Grammy before adding an API key. New installs get about 50 free diagrams: choose Try It Free in setup. Settings shows how many are left, and once they're used up, adding your own Anthropic API key keeps you going. Free diagrams go through Grammy's server on their way to Anthropic, which passes them on without keeping them. With your own key, nothing changes: your prompts go straight to Anthropic. Details: https://github.com/amanmathur99/grammy-releases/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

item.title: Grammy 1.96
item.description:
Improved

  • Grammy now uses Claude Sonnet 5.5, for new diagrams and edits. Diagrams come back faster (about 3.6 seconds instead of 4.3), at the same quality. If you'd picked Sonnet 5 in Settings, you're moved to 5.5.

item.title: Grammy 1.95
item.description:
New

  • A 👎 on finished diagrams. If one isn't right, tap it and choose whether to share that diagram with the developer, so it can be fixed. Nothing is shared unless you tap Share.
  • The editor now shows diagrams the way Grammy draws them: the same clean lettering, sketchy lines and paper background, instead of Excalidraw's handwriting style.

Improved

  • Hovering a diagram keeps it enlarged while you move to the 👎 or close button, and the "Click to open in the editor" hint no longer flickers.
  • Anonymous usage counts now include what kind of diagram was made and whether it was edited, opened in the editor or closed. Never your prompts or diagrams. Details: https://github.com/amanmathur99/grammy-releases/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

item.title: Grammy 1.93
item.description:
Improved

  • Smoother everywhere: the pill no longer jumps when you hover to enlarge a diagram, grows into the live sketch instead of snapping to it, and swaps "Sketching…" for "Copied to clipboard" without the two overlapping.
  • Diagrams update without a flicker of doubled labels as each new version replaces the last.
  • The editor opens with the diagram already drawn and fitted below the toolbar, instead of a blank window that fills in and shifts.
  • The "Click to open in the editor" hint sits in the corner instead of over the diagram's note.

Fixed

  • Moving the pointer off the pill while a diagram is still sketching no longer makes it start to hide and reopen.

item.title: Grammy 1.92
item.description:
New

  • Grammy opens out of the camera notch at the top of the screen and tucks back into it when it's done. On screens without a notch it hangs from the menu bar.
  • One tap of right ⌥ finishes a recording. Double-tap still starts one.
  • A message you've typed but not sent is kept. If the pill closes early or a request fails, it's there when you open it again.
  • Long messages wrap onto up to three lines instead of scrolling sideways.
  • Hover a finished diagram to see it bigger, and click to open it in the editor.
  • Draw outlines: ask for a room, a device, or a region and Grammy sketches its shape, with markers placed inside it.
  • Opus 5.5 is available as a model choice in Settings. Sonnet stays the default.

Fixed

  • Fewer "No speech heard" messages: Grammy keeps listening through pauses instead of dropping what you say after one.
  • The last update to a live sketch no longer redraws the whole diagram from scratch.
  • The editor shows diagrams in their hand-drawn font from the start, without a switch a second later.
  • 2x2s put each quadrant on the right side of its axes, so "urgent" items land on the urgent side.
  • Chart milestones no longer go missing, and their labels sit right by their stars.
  • Text stays off lines: labels avoid curves, axes, markers and box borders, and notes no longer land inside a group they don't describe.
  • Arrows go around boxes instead of through them, and diagrams where everything connects to everything spread out so the arrows are readable.
  • Lines are drawn with a single stroke instead of two that drift apart, and colored text is darker so it's easier to read.

item.title: Grammy 1.9
item.description:
Fixed

  • Words no longer land on top of the lines. Labels on arrows sit beside them, notes avoid arrows as well as shapes, and labels inside charts stack instead of overlapping.
  • Diagrams only rearrange themselves to fit when it doesn't stretch the arrows across the page.

item.title: Grammy 1.8
item.description:
Fixed

  • Grammy now works with Anthropic's newer personal and service account API keys, not just the older workspace ones. If a key covers several workspaces, Grammy asks which to use, or picks it for you when there's only one, and you can change it later in Settings.

item.title: Grammy 1.7
item.description:
New

  • More kinds of diagrams: timelines for anything dated or phased, loops for cycles and feedback, bar charts for comparing amounts, and tables for comparing options side by side.

Improved

  • Diagrams that would come out very wide or very tall rearrange themselves to fit, so the text stays readable.
  • Long flows wrap onto several lines instead of stretching off to the side.
  • Two-way links, like a task going out and an answer coming back, are drawn side by side instead of on top of each other.
  • If Claude returns an almost empty diagram for a detailed description, Grammy quietly tries again.

item.title: Grammy 1.6
item.description:
New

  • Live edits (experimental): turn it on in Settings, and the diagram sketches itself while you're still talking, then finishes on the one you watched build.
  • A close button in the pill's corner when you hover over a diagram.
  • A simpler Settings window, with your shortcuts shown at the top.
  • A shorter, clearer setup for new users, with example prompts to try first.

Improved

  • Edits use Claude Sonnet, so they follow what you ask more reliably.
  • The pill is a true capsule and animates smoothly between typing, sketching and the finished diagram, with no flashes or clipping.
  • The pointer turns into a hand over the diagram, and one click opens the editor.
  • Links that loop back or skip past boxes are drawn around them, not through them.
  • Bigger edits to detailed diagrams no longer fail partway through, and if a change is too big to draw at once, Grammy says so.
  • A fresh look, using Manrope.

Fixed

  • Opening Settings could crash Grammy.
  • Opening the composer could flash your last diagram.

item.title: Grammy 1.5
item.description:
New

  • Grammy now updates itself. It checks once a day and offers new versions when they're ready, or choose Check for Updates… in the menu. This is the last time you'll need to download Grammy by hand.
